description: Remediates CLAUDE-AUTH-001. Adds a canonical patch-body hash (scripts/repair/patch_body_hash.py) that hashes the actual plan_entries content. Extends RealHumanApprovalAdmissionRecord with a `canonical_patch_body_hash` field bound at admission. source_mutation_apply_after_approval recomputes the canonical hash from plan_entries IMMEDIATELY before applying and refuses on mismatch with SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED_BODY_HASH_MISMATCH (or SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED_MISSING_BODY_HASH when the approval lacks the field or the entries cannot produce a valid hash). The clean-diff-with-tampered-bodies attack scenario from the audit is now blocked.
purpose: Rung 1 of the Claude authority leak remediation campaign.

attack_scenario_covered.name: clean-diff-with-tampered-bodies (CLAUDE-AUTH-001)
attack_scenario_covered.description: An adversary supplies observed_diff that matches the approval's diff_hash but plan_entries containing different new_content for the same accepted paths. Before this lock, the apply gate would have written the tampered content. The new canonical-body-hash binding recomputes from plan_entries and refuses with SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED_BODY_HASH_MISMATCH.
